title: Superpower media slot
description: A frame for a photo or video that takes its size, ratio and radius from the caller. Empty, it is a plainly-marked placeholder: a flat muted surface, or on the photo bands a warm amber light falling into the dark.
notes: pass an or
the warm tone uses the theme's glow and highlight colours over the background
name: superpower-media

props.name: media
props.description: the photo or video; it covers the frame. Empty: a placeholder surface

props.name: tone
props.description: placeholder look: muted (flat grey) or warm (amber light into the dark, for photo bands)

props.name: label
props.description: describes the placeholder for screen readers (ignored when media is given)

props.name: className
props.description: size, ratio and radius of the frame

props.name: children
props.description: anything drawn over the media (badges, captions)
